sources.snippet: Track update: This year introduces a dedicated MultiLingual track, and removes Multimodal and Interaction as standalone competition tracks, both are now subsumed into Strict / Strict-Small (paired image-text data and teacher-model feedback are allowed). Evaluation pipeline: The BabyLM 2026 evaluation pipeline is now ready!

sources.snippet: BabyLM 2026: GPT-2 Baselines for the Strict, Strict-Small and Multilingual Tracks This is the codebase that was used to run training for the GPT-2 baselines of the Strict, Strict-Small and Multilingual tracks of the BabyLM 2026 Challenge. Please refer to the Call for Papers for a description of challenge rules for all relevant tracks.
